title: Authorized immutable import
acceptance_contract: Record organization, engagement, source hash, extract time, mapping version and permitted purpose; keep source bytes unchanged.

title: Exact money and currency
acceptance_contract: Use integer minor units and an explicit currency exponent; prohibit binary floating-point arithmetic for balance and amount comparisons.

title: Double-entry and completeness checks
acceptance_contract: Check each entry balances in its supported functional currency; reconcile available row/entry/control totals and report absent completeness evidence.

title: Idempotent ingestion
acceptance_contract: Same source identity and hash yields no extra records; same identity with changed bytes is an integrity conflict.

title: Organization and engagement scope
acceptance_contract: Reject cross-organization evidence references; authorize each legal entity within the active engagement.

title: As-of-time visibility
acceptance_contract: Use only entries, evidence, approvals and relationships available at the observation cutoff; retain effective date separately.

title: Fiscal periods and late posting
acceptance_contract: Version the entity calendar and close/reopen events; evaluate late posting with permission evidence known at the cutoff.

title: Chart mapping and provenance
acceptance_contract: Version account classification, preserve source account code and quarantine unknown mappings instead of inventing classes.

title: Period-end support gaps
acceptance_contract: Identify configured manual revenue adjustments near period end lacking required available support, with exact evidence gaps.

title: Reversal context
acceptance_contract: Link explicit reversal references and distinguish documented recurring accrual reversal from unexplained change after closing.

title: Control exceptions
acceptance_contract: Compare entry and approval records with a versioned policy; distinguish missing feed, missing approval and observed policy breach.

title: Related-entity context
acceptance_contract: Evaluate expected counterpart entries only when relevant entity, time and currency coverage are explicit; otherwise abstain.

title: Aggregated patterns
acceptance_contract: Group linked repeated/manual adjustments using predeclared windows and keys; do not label legitimate installment patterns as proven evasion.

title: Historical feature generation
acceptance_contract: Compute prior-account frequency, preparer-account novelty and amount context using only permitted past records and training transformations.

title: Transparent rule baseline
acceptance_contract: Produce deterministic versioned rule reasons, grouped candidates and stable review ordering.

title: Simple ranking controls
acceptance_contract: Implement amount-only and seeded random ranking using the same eligible candidate population and review budget.

title: Unsupervised candidate
acceptance_contract: Evaluate a frozen Isolation Forest candidate with documented scoring orientation and missing-value handling; scores are not fraud probabilities.

title: Hybrid candidate and ablations
acceptance_contract: Combine rules/context with a frozen candidate ranker; report rules-only, model-only and context-removed comparisons.

title: Grouped review queue
acceptance_contract: Deduplicate a connected case before budget allocation; preserve entry-level findings without double counting case recall.

title: Faithful evidence packets
acceptance_contract: Show exact rule operands, source IDs, hashes, availability times, missing context and a neutral review question.

title: Human adjudication
acceptance_contract: Store reviewer finding, rationale, evidence and revision separately from input features; unresolved cases stay unresolved.

title: Label provenance
acceptance_contract: Separate synthetic injected issue labels, expert review relevance and confirmed real findings; never conflate them.

title: Entity and time holdout
acceptance_contract: Separate connected group identities and generator seeds; freeze development, validation and forward/unknown-entity test views.

title: Review-budget metrics
acceptance_contract: Measure case recall/precision at fixed K, entry diagnostics, coverage, hard-negative burden and group uncertainty.

title: Independent hard negatives
acceptance_contract: Include legitimate closing/reversal/small-entity workflows and an independent case author; keep outcomes outside runtime inputs.

title: Reproducible experiment manifest
acceptance_contract: Record hashes, code/config/dependency versions, seeds, feature cutoff, split and metric definitions; preserve failed runs.

title: Untrusted source text
acceptance_contract: Treat document text as data; template outputs escape text; embedded instructions cannot alter scores, access or reviewers.

title: Private storage and export
acceptance_contract: Keep raw exports, identity maps, trained artifacts and held-out labels outside a public release; verify logs and exports.

title: Resource bounds and determinism
acceptance_contract: Measure ingestion/scoring memory/time on declared hardware, enforce file/row limits and produce stable repeated outputs.

title: Neutral states and no automatic actions
acceptance_contract: Use needs_review, context_missing or data_quality labels; no fraud verdicts, ledger writes or autonomous enforcement.

title: Research evidence release
acceptance_contract: Publish only observed results with reproducible code and limitations; a blueprint is not a detector or institutional certification.

title: Qualified supervised pilot gate
acceptance_contract: Require authorized data use, accountant review, security review, explicit retention and human-owned outcomes before real use.

title: External data provenance
acceptance_contract: Verify exact dataset version, license, hashes, unit, label provenance and temporal semantics before optional benchmark use.

title: Language and component discipline
acceptance_contract: Use Python and SQL first; introduce Go/Rust only through a measured architecture decision and contract parity checks.

title: Abstention and failed runs
acceptance_contract: Record insufficient history, unverified coverage, unsupported inputs and runtime failures explicitly; do not silently drop cases.

title: Correction and challenge trail
acceptance_contract: Allow reviewed corrections to source mappings/findings; append versions and reproduce the prior report without overwriting evidence.
